title: Boldteq Shopify Website — discovery goals.json contract (#13)
description: The machine-readable brief every build anchors to (shopify-technical-goals-discovery.md §1). Top-level areas are REQUIRED as objects; the canonical lift-driving numeric fields accept a number OR null (null = unknown-at-discovery, never an adjective). Extra fields are allowed (additionalProperties is open) — niches add their own. This schema is the published TYPE contract agents author against + the validation pass that catches malformed shapes (e.g. a target captured as text). The QUALITY rules — empty priority_surfaces, missing cvr_target, adjective-as-target, stub brand-direction — are enforced procedurally by check-discovery.mjs, not here.
